words.ex_cn: 每天早上国旗都高高飘扬。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of a nation; common to a whole nation

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 成功做成某事；在做某事上取得成功
words.ex: He will succeed in doing something if he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果他努力，他就会成功做成某事。
words.en: To achieve a desired outcome or complete a task successfully.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: The temperature remains high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度保持很高。
words.en: If someone or something remains in a particular state or condition, they stay in that state or condition and do not change.

words.ex: He did not take notice of the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他没有注意到那个警告标志。
words.en: To become aware of something or someone, especially by seeing or hearing them.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.ex: He showed great spirit when he tried again after failing.
words.ex_cn: 他在失败后再次尝试时展现了极大的精神。
words.en: The part of a person that includes their mind, feelings, and character rather than their body.

words.ex: He is a jew who celebrates Passover.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位庆祝逾越节的犹太人。
words.en: A Jew is a person whose religion is Judaism, or who is descended from the ancient Hebrew people.

words.tr: 短语动词. 躲藏起来；隐匿；避人耳目
words.ex: The criminal decided to go into hiding after the robbery.
words.ex_cn: v. 抢劫后，罪犯决定躲藏起来。
words.en: To go into hiding means to hide oneself, especially to avoid being found or caught.

words.tr:
n. 纳粹党人
adj. 纳粹党的
words.ex: He hated the nazi regime.
words.ex_cn: 他憎恨纳粹政权。
words.en: A member of the National Socialist German Workers' Party, which controlled Germany from 1933 to 1945 under Adolf Hitler.

words.ex: Many people die of cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在冬天死于寒冷。
words.en: To die of something means to die because of a particular cause, such as an illness or an accident.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事（病以外）而死
words.ex: He died from a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他因车祸去世。
words.en: If someone dies from a particular cause, that cause is the reason for their death.

words.tr:
adj. 德国的；
n. 德语；德国人；
words.ex: She speaks German music and eats German food.
words.ex_cn: 她听德国音乐，吃德国食物。
words.en: relating to Germany, its people, or their language

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.ex: He showed courage when he saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他从火中救出孩子时展现了勇气。
words.en: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.

words.tr: phrase. 因担心自身生命安全而害怕；生怕丧命
words.ex: He ran away in fear of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他因为害怕丢掉性命而逃跑了。
words.en: If someone is in fear of their life, they are afraid that they are in danger of being killed.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: To my surprise, he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 让我惊讶的是，他通过了考试。
words.en: used to express that someone is surprised by something

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；合意的；宜人的；
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is pleasant is enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: Dance is an art form that expresses emotion.
words.ex_cn: 舞蹈是一种表达情感的艺术形式。
words.en: An art form is a specific form of artistic expression that is characterized by a particular style or method.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He listens to pop music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听流行音乐。
words.en: Pop music is a genre of popular music that originated in its modern form during the mid-1950s in the United States and the United Kingdom.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.ex: He is known for his kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他以善良著称。
words.en: If someone or something is known for a particular quality or feature, they are famous or recognized because of it.

words.ex: He is famous for singing beautiful songs.
words.ex_cn: 他因演唱动听的歌曲而闻名。
words.en: be widely known or recognized for a particular quality or achievement

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: He completed the task successfully.
words.ex_cn: 他成功地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that accomplishes a desired aim or result.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The bell rang at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 铃在早上八点响了。
words.en: A bell is a device that makes a ringing sound and is used to give a signal or to attract attention.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

words.ex: The river is the dividing line between the two towns.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个城镇的分界线。
words.en: A dividing line is a line that separates two areas or groups, or marks a boundary between them.

words.ex: He is highly talented.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有才华。
words.en: to a high degree or level; very

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.tr: phrase. 喘不过气来的；上气不接下气的
words.ex: He ran fast and was out of breath.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，气喘吁吁。
words.en: If you are out of breath, you are breathing very quickly and with difficulty, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: He loves to listen to folk music on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末听民谣音乐。
words.en: Folk music is music that originates in traditional popular culture or that is written in such a style. Folk music is typically of unknown authorship and is transmitted orally from generation to generation.

words.ex: He listens to country music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听乡村音乐。
words.en: A genre of popular music that originated in the rural regions of the Southern United States, blending traditional folk music with elements of blues and gospel.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.tr: phrase. 摇滚乐；摇滚音乐（一种以电吉他、贝斯和鼓为主要乐器，节奏强烈、富有活力的流行音乐形式）
words.ex: He listens to rock music every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都听摇滚音乐。
words.en: Rock music is a genre of popular music that originated as 'rock and roll' in the United States in the 1950s, and developed into a range of different styles in the 1960s and later.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: The cowboy rode his horse across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔骑着马穿过沙漠。
words.en: A cowboy is a man who herds cattle, traditionally in the western United States, and is often depicted as wearing a wide-brimmed hat and boots.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.tr: phrase. 非裔美国人的；指具有非洲血统的美国公民
words.ex: He is an African American teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位非裔美国教师。
words.en: An African American is a person of African descent living in the United States.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. （文艺作品等的）地方特色，乡土色彩
words.ex: The painting shows local color with bright folk costumes.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画通过鲜艳的民间服饰展现了地方特色。
words.en: Local color refers to the distinctive character, customs, and scenery of a particular place, often used in literature and art to evoke a sense of place.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.tr: 短语动词，有……的天赋；擅长于……
words.ex: He has a gift for drawing animals.
words.ex_cn: 他有画动物的天赋。
words.en: To have a natural ability to do something well.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr: v. 完成；“do”的过去分词； adj. 已完成的；
words.ex: I done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我完成了我的作业。
words.en: If something is done, it has been completed or finished.

words.ex: He watches a chat show every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一个谈话节目。
words.en: A chat show is a television or radio programme in which people talk to a host in an informal way, often answering questions about their lives or work.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 戏剧系列；电视剧集
words.ex: He watches a drama series every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一部电视剧。
words.en: A drama series is a television program that consists of a sequence of episodes, often telling a continuous story or focusing on the lives of the characters.

words.tr: phrase. 游戏节目；竞赛类电视节目
words.ex: He watches a game show every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一个游戏节目。
words.en: A game show is a type of radio, television, or internet programming where contestants compete for prizes by playing games of knowledge or skill.

words.ex: This math problem is from real-life.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题来自现实生活。
words.en: Involving or depicting actual events or people; not fictional.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.ex: The teacher gave a round-up of the week's lessons.
words.ex_cn: 老师对本周的课程做了总结。
words.en: A round-up is a summary or collection of information or news items, or the act of gathering animals or people together.

words.tr: adj. 最新的；最近的；新式的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up-to-date by reading news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天读新闻来保持知识的更新。
words.en: Someone or something that is up-to-date has the most recent information or uses the newest methods or equipment.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是足球的忠实粉丝。
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: v. 来；到来；“come”的现在分词； adj. 即将发生的； n. 到来；来临；
words.ex: He is coming to my house tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要来我家。
words.en: The act of arriving or the arrival of something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr:
adj. 亚洲的；
n. 亚洲人；
words.ex: He eats asian food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃亚洲食物。
words.en: relating to Asia or its people, customs, or languages

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.ex: He watched a music video on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的手机上看了一个音乐视频。
words.en: A music video is a short film or video that integrates a song with imagery, and is produced for promotional or artistic purposes.

words.ex: I watched a new mv on YouTube yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天在YouTube上看了一支新的音乐视频。
words.en: to move a file or directory from one location to another in a computer system

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.tr: phrase. 短信；短消息；正文消息
words.ex: He sent a text message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友发了一条短信。
words.en: A text message is a written message that you send using a mobile phone.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.ex: The murderer was caught by the police.
words.ex_cn: 杀人犯被警察抓住了。
words.en: A murderer is a person who has committed the crime of murder.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr: n. 爱护动物者；动物爱好者
words.ex: He is an animal-lover who feeds stray cats every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个动物爱好者，每天喂流浪猫。
words.en: A person who has a strong affection for animals and often supports their welfare.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: His silly hat made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他那可笑的帽子让大家都笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is silly, you mean that they are foolish, childish, or ridiculous.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.ex: He is a superstar in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球界的超级巨星。
words.en: A superstar is a person who is extremely famous and successful, especially in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: You think you can beat me? In your dreams!
words.ex_cn: 你以为你能打败我？做梦吧！
words.en: used to express that something is unlikely to happen or is unrealistic

words.tr: phrase. 如此……以至于……（引导结果状语从句）
words.ex: He was so tired that he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，很快就睡着了。
words.en: Used to indicate the result or consequence of something being extremely the case.

words.ex: He loves to watch action film on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看动作片。
words.en: An action film is a film genre in which the protagonist or protagonists are thrust into a series of events that typically include violence, extended fighting, physical feats, and frantic chases.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.ex: He likes to read science fiction books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Science fiction is a genre of speculative fiction that typically deals with imaginative and futuristic concepts such as advanced science and technology, space exploration, time travel, parallel universes, and extraterrestrial life. It has been called the 'literature of ideas', and often explores the potential consequences of scientific, social, and technological innovations.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.tr: phrase. 如此……以至于（用于引导结果状语从句，表示某种程度或结果）
words.ex: He was such a good singer that everyone clapped.
words.ex_cn: 他是个如此好的歌手，以至于每个人都鼓掌了。
words.en: Used to introduce a clause indicating the result of something being so extreme or of such a kind.

words.ex: The old man is a good storyteller.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是个出色的故事讲述者。
words.en: A storyteller is someone who tells or writes stories.

words.ex: He wrote a script for a short movie.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部短片写了剧本。
words.en: A script is the written form of a play, film, or broadcast. It includes the dialogue and stage directions.

words.ex: He is the all-time best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队历史上最棒的球员。
words.en: You use all-time to describe something that is the best, worst, greatest, or most extreme of its kind that has ever existed.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.tr: adj. 人道主义的；慈善的；
words.ex: The humanitarian aid helped the hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 人道主义援助帮助了饥饿的孩子们。
words.en: A humanitarian is someone who is involved in or connected with improving people's lives and reducing suffering.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.ex: The dancer moved gracefully on stage.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者在舞台上优雅地舞动。
words.en: A dancer is someone who dances or whose job is dancing.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.tr: phrase. 吸引某人的注意；引起某人关注
words.ex: The bright colors catch my attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色引起了我的注意。
words.en: To attract someone's notice or interest.

words.ex: She insists on going home now.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决要求现在回家。
words.en: If you insist on doing something, you keep doing it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.tr: phrase. 扮演…的角色；起…的作用
words.ex: He will play the role of a teacher in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将在学校的话剧中扮演老师的角色。
words.en: to act as a specific character in a play, film, or other performance

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.ex: He got a nomination for best actor.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳男演员的提名。
words.en: The act of officially suggesting someone or something for a position, prize, or honor.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: The child drew a picture of an angel with wings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅有翅膀的天使的画。
words.en: An angel is a spiritual being believed to act as a messenger or servant of God, conventionally represented in human form with wings and a long robe.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.tr: adv. 和平地；平静地；和谐地
words.ex: The village is nestled peacefully in the valley.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄平静地坐落在山谷中。
words.en: In a manner that is free from disturbance or conflict; calmly.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.ex: The traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The rush hour is one of the periods of the day when most people are travelling to or from work.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.tr: adj. 吃惊的；惊奇的； v. 使惊奇；使吃惊；“amaze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was amazed by the magic show.
words.ex_cn: 我对这场魔术表演感到吃惊。
words.en: If you are amazed by something, you are very surprised by it.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看错成；把…误解成
words.ex: He often mistakes the cat for the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他经常把猫错认成狗。
words.en: To confuse someone or something with another person or thing.

words.ex: He practices kung fu every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习功夫。
words.en: Kung fu refers to the Chinese martial arts, which are a series of fighting styles that have developed over the centuries in China.

words.ex: He bought a DVD of the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张新电影的数字化视频光盘。
words.en: A DVD is a disk similar to a compact disk on which a large amount of information, especially high-quality video, can be stored.

words.tr: phrase. 数字视频光盘；数字影碟
words.ex: He rented a digital video disc to watch at home.
words.ex_cn: 他租了一张数字视频光盘在家观看。
words.en: A digital video disc (DVD) is a type of optical disc storage media format, invented and developed in 1995. DVDs offer higher storage capacity than compact discs while having the same dimensions.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: He told a tale about a brave knight.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于勇敢骑士的故事。
words.en: A tale is a story, especially one that is full of exciting or magical events.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.tr: phrase. 爱上某人；对某人产生爱情
words.ex: She fell in love with him the moment she saw him.
words.ex_cn: 她见到他的那一刻就爱上了他。
words.en: To begin to feel romantic love for someone.

words.ex: The store has a special offer on milk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店对牛奶有特价优惠。
words.en: A special offer is a product or service that is offered for sale at a lower price than usual for a short period of time.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr:
adv. 两者都不；
adj. 两者都不的；
conj. 也不；
pron. 两者都不；
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and neither do I like tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a further negative statement after a negative one, or to indicate that a negative statement is also true of another person or thing

words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.ex: The stuntman performed a dangerous motorcycle jump.
words.ex_cn: 特技替身演员表演了一个危险的摩托车跳跃。
words.en: A stuntman is a person who performs dangerous stunts, especially in films or television, as a substitute for an actor.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: The detective solved the mystery with clues.
words.ex_cn: 侦探用线索破解了谜案。
words.en: A detective is someone whose job is to discover what has happened in a crime or other situation and to find the people involved.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.tr: adj. 失去的；失踪的； v. 错失；“miss”的现在分词；
words.ex: The missing book was found under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 那本丢失的书在床下找到了。
words.en: If someone or something is missing, they are not in their usual place, and you cannot find them.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: His room is untidy.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很凌乱。
words.en: If you describe something as untidy, you mean that it is not neat or well arranged.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.tr: adj. 工资高的（工作）；收入高的（人）
words.ex: He is a well-paid engineer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名高薪的工程师。
words.en: A well-paid job or position is one for which you are paid a lot of money.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: It rained heavily last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚雨下得很大。
words.en: To a great degree; in large amounts.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr:
n. 指纹；指印
v. 采指纹
words.ex: The police found his fingerprint on the glass.
words.ex_cn: 警察在玻璃上找到了他的指纹。
words.en: A fingerprint is a mark made by the pattern of ridges on the pad of a human finger, used for identification purposes.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.ex: My boss gives me work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的老板每天早上给我安排工作。
words.en: A boss is a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.ex: This problem has nothing to do with math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学无关。
words.en: If you say that something has nothing to do with a particular subject or situation, you mean that it is not connected with it in any way.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.ex: The police caught the man after the kidnapping.
words.ex_cn: 警方在绑架案后抓住了那个男人。
words.en: The act of taking someone away illegally by force, typically to obtain a ransom.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He is in prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃而入狱。
words.en: being confined in a prison as a punishment for a crime

words.tr:
v. 绑架；劫持；诱拐
n. 绑架罪
words.ex: The man tried to kidnap the little girl.
words.ex_cn: 这个人试图绑架那个小女孩。
words.en: To take someone away illegally by force, typically to obtain a ransom.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.tr: phrase. v. 防止某事发生；提防某事物
words.ex: Wear a helmet to guard against head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To take precautions in order to avoid something undesirable.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewellery to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewellery consists of objects that are worn for personal adornment, such as bracelets, rings, necklaces, and earrings, often made from precious metals and gemstones.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewelry to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewelry refers to decorative items worn for personal adornment, such as brooches, rings, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets. Jewelry may be attached to the body or the clothes, and the term is restricted to durable ornaments, excluding flowers for example.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without their permission and without intending to return it.
